integrity: An accompanying plain Python program reproduces the finite checks independently of the structural classification. Finite checks are supplemental, not proofs for arbitrary orders. Sources are credited without claims of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The original contribution is the exact token-jump diameter and matching reconfiguration structure for one-subdivided complete graphs. The count of functions avoiding 1- and 2-cycles, and its closed inclusion-exclusion expression, are prior art (OEIS A134362). The theorem has a complete general proof and finite predicate checks; publication priority and independent review are not established.
title: Sharp token-jump diameter and two maximal-matching strata in subdivided complete graphs
